title: 第17章 山海鬼市第18章 符章雕版
content_zh:
“南山之外，时有云气，如宫室、台观、城堞、人物、车马、冠盖，历历可见，谓之山海之市。或曰：‘蛟蜃之气所为。”
南山郡有一奇景，每到大雾漫天之时，登城楼而望，偶尔就能见到云雾之中忽现城郭、台榭、人物往来，如神山仙乡，偶尔在世人面前展现真容。
但人远望时，望之如真，一旦靠近，反而迷失于大雾中。
大风一吹，云雾散去，终究是一场幻梦。
所以，世人称之为“山海鬼市！”
……
“快看，鬼市出来了！”
“若真有仙家圣地，也就不过如此了罢！真想进去看看啊！”
“想得美！这只是幻觉，不知多少痴儿，把这鬼市当真，迷失了大山云雾中，脱了一层皮才从鬼打墙中脱身出来！”
……
南山多山，山中多雾。
这一日，又是山海鬼市出现的一天，城楼上站了不少看热闹的文人墨客，谈性十足，满是好奇和恐惧。
而就在无人注意时，一道消瘦身影已然没入大雾中，消失不见，直朝他们口中人踪难觅的鬼市而去。
“南山云海空复空，群仙出没空明中。荡摇浮世生万象，岂有贝阙藏珠宫？”
吴燃灯头戴斗笠，不露真容，看着云雾中宫殿数十，碧瓦飞甍，悠悠而想。
世人不识仙容，哪怕有幸得见，也无法辨别真假，白白错过。
这山海鬼市，不是虚假，只是凡俗不可入而已。
那些被凡人误认作幻象的亭台楼阁、往来人影，实则是修仙之人所隐居的仙道隐市。
大更王朝，乃是气运王朝，以王朝气运镇压一国之地，不容人以法术乱了凡世。
哪怕是修仙之人，法力在身，也挡不住天生能破万法的王朝龙气，只能乖乖退隐。

仙道隐世，除了陆、方、司乐这些得了王朝承认的仙族可以扎根凡地，其他隐修、小族都得避居世外。
修仙者也是人，是人就会聚族而居，逐渐壮大，就成了这山中避世的山海鬼市。
这云中蜃楼不是障眼法，而是天地间气候变化，气机交感之下，破开了修仙隐市的阵法屏障，将鬼市的一些景象显现在世人面前。
若真有凡人寻来，又会被阵法迷幻，如鬼打墙一般迷失在大山中。
直到云雾散去，阵法重新隐世。
这些凡人才能挣脱出来，只是到那时候，肉体凡胎早就脱了一层皮，渐渐就再也无人敢靠近了。
而吴燃灯却没有这重顾虑。
山海鬼市，肉眼难寻。
而修仙之人，只要静心凝神，就能感受到空中灵气散布，那灵气空洞之处，就是阵法留下的道路。
吴燃灯步伐左折右拐，不走寻常直线，只是寻着灵气空隙，步伐鬼魅。
突然他身形一拐，竟是凭空破开一个无形的屏障，如入镜面一般，消失不见。
若是凡人见到，非要惊呼见鬼。
吴燃灯眼前风景陡变，一下子从空寂的山间，来到了人声沸腾的闹市。
攒动的人影、悬在半空的招牌，听见此起彼伏的吆喝。
“刚出炉的聚气丹！”“上品符箓换妖兽内丹咯！”
两边店家悬着的幡旗，上面写着“丹”“器”“符”等字样。
吴燃灯拾级而上，每走一步，石阶深深。
行至半途，迎面撞见个挑着药担的老翁，老翁的草鞋沾着露水，药担里飘出的灵气却精纯得惊人。
吴燃灯摸了摸怀里的符章，知道自己已踏入这隐于幻象中的仙道隐市。
content_en:
"Beyond the Nanshan Mountains, there are often clouds, such as palaces, terraces, battlements, people, chariots and horses, and crowns. They are clearly visible. It is called the city of mountains and seas. Or it is said to be 'caused by the mirage's energy."
There is a wonderful scene in Nanshan County. Every time when there is heavy fog in the sky, if you climb the city tower and look up, you can occasionally see the city walls, pavilions, and people coming and going among the clouds and mist. It is like a sacred mountain and fairyland, and occasionally its true appearance is revealed in front of the world.
But when people look at it from a distance, it seems real. Once they get closer, they are lost in the fog.
When the wind blows, the clouds and fog disperse, it is just a dream after all.
Therefore, the world calls it the "Ghost City of Mountains and Seas!"
…
"Look, the ghost market is out!"
"If there really is a holy land of the Immortal Family, it's nothing more than this! I really want to go in and have a look!"
"It's a beautiful thought! This is just an illusion. I don't know how many idiots have taken this ghost market seriously. They got lost in the mountains and clouds, and only after shedding a layer of skin did they escape from the ghost market!"
…
Nanshan is mountainous and foggy in the mountains.
This day is another day when the Shanhai Ghost Market appears. There are many literati and poets standing on the tower watching the excitement, chatting with each other, full of curiosity and fear.
And when no one was paying attention, a thin figure had already disappeared into the heavy fog, heading straight towards the ghost market that they said was hard to find.
"The sea of clouds in Nanshan is empty again, and immortals appear and appear in the sky. With all the phenomena in the floating world, how can there be a Bei Que Pearl Palace?"
Wu Randeng wore a bamboo hat on his head, not showing his true face, and thought leisurely as he looked at dozens of palaces in the clouds and mist, with green tiles and flying feathers.
The world does not know the appearance of immortals. Even if they are lucky enough to see them, they cannot distinguish between true and false, and they will miss them in vain.
This ghost market of mountains and seas is not fake, it is just inaccessible to the common people.
Those pavilions, pavilions, and people coming and going that are misunderstood by mortals as illusions are actually the secluded cities of immortality where cultivators live in seclusion.
The Da Geng Dynasty was a dynasty of luck. It suppressed a country with the luck of the dynasty and did not allow people to use magic to disrupt the world.
Even those who are cultivating immortals, with magic power in their bodies, cannot stop the dynasty dragon energy that is born to break all magic, so they can only retreat obediently.
In the secluded world of immortality, except for the immortal clans recognized by the dynasty such as Lu, Fang, and Sile, who can take root in the mortal world, other hermits and small clans have to stay away from the world.
Immortal cultivators are also human beings, and they will live together in groups and gradually grow stronger, becoming this ghost city of mountains and seas in the mountains.
This mirage in the clouds is not a deception, but a change in the climate between heaven and earth. Under the interaction of Qi, it breaks through the formation barrier of Xiuxian Hidden City and reveals some scenes of the ghost market to the world.
If a mortal really comes looking for it, he will be enchanted by the formation and get lost in the mountains like a ghost breaking through a wall.
Until the clouds and fog dissipated, the formation was hidden from the world again.
Only these mortals can break free, but by then, the mortal body has already shed a layer of skin, and gradually no one dares to come close.
But Wu Randeng didn't have such worries.
The ghost city of mountains and seas is hard to find with the naked eye.
As for those who are cultivating immortals, as long as they calm down and concentrate, they can feel the spiritual energy spreading in the air. The holes in the spiritual energy are the paths left by the formation.
Wu Randeng's steps turned left and right, not walking in an ordinary straight line, but looking for gaps in spiritual energy, his steps were ghostly.
Suddenly, he turned around and broke through an invisible barrier out of thin air, disappearing as if entering a mirror.
If a mortal saw it, he would scream that it was a ghost.
The scenery in front of Wu Randeng suddenly changed, from the deserted mountains to the bustling bustling city.
There were moving figures, signboards hanging in the air, and shouts one after another.
"The newly released Qi Gathering Pill!" "The high-grade talisman is replaced by the Demonic Beast Inner Pill!"
The flags hung by the shops on both sides have the words "Dan", "Qi" and "Fu" written on them.
Wu Randeng climbed up the stairs. Every step he took, the stone steps were deep.
Halfway through the journey, I bumped into an old man carrying a medicine load. The old man's straw sandals were stained with dew, but the aura floating out of the medicine load was surprisingly pure.
Wu Randeng touched the talisman in his arms and knew that he had stepped into the fairyland hidden in the illusion.
